thread:
maya: Quick question — thinking about surfacing routing/quota context on SLO alerts in the console (and in webhook notify payloads). Right now alerts show metric + threshold but not which routing policy or quota bucket triggered. Would be super helpful for oncall. Thoughts?

liam: +1. Hard to debug when an alert fires and we don't know if it was hit because of tenant spillover or a routing fallback. :eyes: 

kevin: We could add an "alert_context" blob to notify payload with {routing_policy_id, quota_snapshot, active_model_variant, recent_rollout}. Concern: cardinality and payload size.

tess: UI question — do we show full blob on the alert card or a collapsed 'Show routing details'? Prefer collapse with key-value highlights.

dana: Implementation note: telemetry pipeline only retains per-request routing hints for 48h. If we add to payload we either have to enrich at evaluation time (cheap) or fetch logs (expensive).

maya: Enriching at evaluation time sounds right. Proposal: add 'route_hint' with fields: policy, route_id, priority_tier, tenant_quota_used_pct. Plus small 'quota_snapshot' {limit, used, window}.

liam: +1 to that shape. Example webhook snippet:

```
"alert_context": {
  "route_hint": {"policy":"spillover-v2","route_id":"r-42","priority":"low"},
  "quota_snapshot": {"limit":100000,"used":87321,"window":"1h"}
}
```

kevin: also add 'fallback_reason' like "capacity_exhausted" or "model_mismatch" — helps automation.

tess: UX nit: show 'used_pct' instead of raw numbers on card, with 'details' panel for raw values.

dana: ops: watch out for PII — don't add tenant identifiers in plaintext to alerts sent to external integrations. We can include tenant_hash or mask.

maya: Good call. Use tenant_hash and make including raw tenant id opt-in via org settings.

telemetry-bot: Note saved: proposal to add alert_context to notify payload; follow-up RFC requested. /cc @product

liam: I'll draft RFC and include perf cost estimates and retention implications. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maya: Awesome — thanks, @liam. If anyone has sample queries to simulate enrichment, drop them here.

kevin: I'll paste a small enrichment SQL later.
